sections.text: Answer to last week: Veery Thrush
sections.title: Who's That Noisy

sections.text:
Item #1: In a recent paper computer scientists argue that the soon to be developed quantum computers will completely destroy all existing internet security.
Item #2: The first global map of water in the Moon’s soil shows a patchy pattern largely confined to the poles.
Item #3: A new study finds that squirrels organize their nut caches by various criteria, such as type and quality.
sections.title: Science or Fiction

sections.text: 'The three great essentials to achieve anything worthwhile are, first, hard work; second, stick-to-itiveness; third, common sense.' - Thomas A. Edison
